source.author: verg
source.text: Haud aliter terras inter caelumque volabat, litus harenosum Libyae ventosque secabat materno veniens ab avo Cyllenia proles.
source.text_original: Haud aliter terras inter caelumque volabat, / litus harenosum Libyae ventosque secabat / materno veniens ab avo Cyllenia proles.
source.text_english: No otherwise was the Cyllenian offspring, coming from her maternal grandfather, flying between earth and sky, and cleaving the sandy shore of Libya and the winds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hinc numerosa phalanx, proles Cyllenia: certus Aethalides subitas nervo redeunte sagittas cogere; tu medios gladio bonus ire per hostes, Euryte; nec patrio Minyis ignobilis usu, nuntia verba ducis populis qui reddit, Echion.
reuse.text_original: hinc numerosa phalanx, proles Cyllenia: certus / Aethalides subitas nervo redeunte sagittas / cogere; tu medios gladio bonus ire per hostes, / Euryte; nec patrio Minyis ignobilis usu, / nuntia verba ducis populis qui reddit, Echion.
reuse.text_english: from here a numerous phalanx, the Cyllenian offspring: Aethalides knows well how to draw back the bowstring and force the arrows to return in a sudden flight; you, Euryte, are good at going with sword through the midst of the enemy; nor are you unworthy among the Minyae in your ancestral skill, Echion, when he brings back to the peoples the words of the leader and reports them.
